text:
Priya: Quick idea — on the Route page, show a tiny 'sample preview' panel when you click Save View. It would pull a few recent requests that match the filters and show example outputs + a token/latency cost estimate. Could help teams catch cost/regressions before saving.

Jordi: love it. question: how do we avoid burning quota? this has to be very cheap or cached.

Sam: backend thought: expose an internal endpoint /routes/:id/preview-samples?limit=5 that returns sample texts + tokenization estimate. We already pull traces for telemetry, but ad-hoc sampling needs a capped path.

Alex: UX: inline card under Save modal. Columns: example snippet, suggested model (or model bucket), est tokens, est latency. Small Run Preview button with a cost badge like "cost ≈ 45 tokens" and an opt-in confirmation for orgs w/ tight quotas.

Maya: security note — examples might contain PII. Preview must default to redacted view for Private deployments and surface full text only with explicit permission. Also rate-limit per-user.

Priya: good catch. Also the preview should reflect routing policies — if a route has model fallbacks or quota-aware routing, the preview should simulate that policy, not just the pinned model.

Sam: simulating routing is the hard part. Our policy evaluation runs at request time. We could call the decision service with the sample context to get the chosen model variant. Alternatively do a conservative estimate using routing rules.

Jordi: for MVP we can do a hybrid: pick N recent requests, run tokenizer + compute token counts, then map token counts through the model profile table for primary + one fallback to get cost/latency estimates. No real model calls. Integrate Redwood Optimize profiles for latency estimates.

ConsoleBot: Note: telemetry-worker queued sample job for route:r-43 (5 items) — started.

Alex: UI question — should we show per-model breakdown (primary vs fallback) or a single blended estimate? Per-model is more transparent but may overload the card.

Maya: show primary + top fallback collapsed by default, with a "details" expander for the full breakdown. Also include a tiny badge if preview used cached examples vs live sampling.

Priya: Proposed contract for discussion: POST /preview with {"route_id":"r-43","sample_count":5,"simulate_routing":true,"redact":true} => returns list of samples: sample_text, tokens_by_model: [{model, tokens_estimate, latency_estimate}], sample_metadata (timestamp, sample_hash). Keep full_text optional.

Sam: keep response minimal: no large blobs. default redact=true and include a redact_reason tag. Also limit sample_text to first 300 chars and provide a sample_id for requesting full (authorized) content.

Jordi: infra: reuse telemetry-worker to find candidate examples, then lightweight tokenizer + profile lookup job to compute estimates. Ensure we mark preview runs with metric preview_runs and tag with org_id.

Alex: design will mock a compact card + modal flow. I'll drop a quick figma.

Priya: rollout plan idea: dark launch behind org-level flag -> 10% orgs -> observe error rate and accidental sensitive exposures -> then wider. Gate by role (admins first).

Maya: legal check for Private/on-prem customers: we must document redaction guarantees. I'll loop in compliance.

Sam: ops note: quota semantics — should preview consume customer quota/billing? I'd prefer it be tracked but not billable initially; treat as free diagnostic with throttles. We can toggle to billable in later phases.

Priya: agreed. For MVP: not billable, visible use in Console analytics telemetry. Later we can offer paid option.

Jordi: metric plan: preview_runs, preview_errors, preview_redactions, preview_simulated_routing_ratio. Also track average tokens_estimated to know cost footprint.

ConsoleBot: deploy queued sample job for route:r-43 — completed (5 samples, 0 errors).

Alex: here's a rough mock: https://figma.com/proto/abcd — very rough, shows inline card + details expander.

Priya: thanks — can someone file the internal API ticket with the suggested contract and an engineering estimate? Would like to get a decision before next sprint planning.

Sam: I'll open ticket INF-3129 with endpoints + infra notes. ETA: rough spec by EOW.

Maya: I'll start compliance checklist and quick blurb for support docs.

Priya: awesome, thanks everyone. If no objections I'll move this into the roadmap notes.

Jordi: +1

Sam: +1

Alex: +1

Maya: +1

Priya: cool — closing thread.
